claim: Exact published source capability review; neither package is measured or counted as beaten.

decisions.name: pvec
decisions.reason: Persistent vector, not a complete key/value snapshot engine. Candidate backing for dense rows, with an explicit key index. Its arc feature is required for cross-thread retained views. First cloning a flat representation constructs a tree; account for conversion and compare tree-start mode as well. small_branch is a separate compile-time variation, requiring its own pinned binary and matched controls. Additional Debug bound must not narrow the generic row API without an explicit wrapper.

decisions.name: ordermap
decisions.reason: Wrapper over IndexMap providing order-sensitive collection semantics. Clone delegates to the underlying IndexMap. Default remove uses shift removal, while explicit swap_remove delegates to IndexMap swap removal. Adapt actual OrderMap with native/fast builders and explicit removal policy; do not count it as an independent indexing algorithm or infer its measured speed from another crate.
